Bundled offline animation dependencies

flip-toolkit 7.2.6 (MIT)
https://github.com/aholachek/react-flip-toolkit
Downloaded from https://unpkg.com/flip-toolkit@7.2.6/lib/index.umd.js
Used by card-transition.js for spring settling. The app-specific geometry,
image cropping, touch handling and Android predictive-back adapter are local.
License: flip-toolkit-LICENSE.txt

rematrix 0.2.2 (MIT), required by the flip-toolkit UMD bundle
https://github.com/jlmakes/rematrix
Downloaded from https://unpkg.com/rematrix@0.2.2/dist/rematrix.js
License: rematrix-LICENSE.txt

These files ship with the APK; no CDN requests are made at runtime.
